source: Public and true faces of the two-face focuses of docs/design/focus/worshipdom.json (decision D7). The focus data names [zin_wsd_<key>_name] and [zin_wsd_<key>_desc]; the Afrit mechanic module defines those scripted localisations from this table: public text while zin_afrit_revealed is unset, true text after. Written by the Worshipdom tree author; regenerate with the tree, never by hand.

seat_of_whispers.desc_public: A chapter of couriers is founded at the Hermitage. They carry letters, learn languages and are welcome at any court that has a table and a chair.
seat_of_whispers.desc_true: The first seat of the Council of the Deliverer takes its place: the Seat of Whispers, which gathers what every court wishes hidden.

ears_in_sonargur.desc_public: The Hermitage makes friends at the court of Sonargur, where the sea-kings are sometimes proud and sometimes lonely. A friendly ear is always welcome.
ears_in_sonargur.desc_true: Your couriers listen at the Leren court. What they hear of the sea-kings' grievances is written down and sent to the Seat.

watchers_of_the_south.desc_public: Pilgrims go south to Mirolon and are welcomed by the keepers of the passes. They pray at the shrines and are shown the walls.
watchers_of_the_south.desc_true: Your pilgrims count the passes of Mirolon, its garrisons and the storms that guard them. They report to the Seat of Whispers.

the_eastern_chapter.desc_public: A chapter of the Hermitage opens in the East, with a hospital, a school and a guest-house for travelling merchants. The kings of the East are courteous and curious.
the_eastern_chapter.desc_true: The Eastern Branch of the Council is founded. The reserve seat of the Deliverer begins to take root in the courts of the East.

merchants_gossip.desc_public: Merchants bring news to the Hermitage along with their prayers. The scribes write down what they hear and file it away.
merchants_gossip.desc_true: Your listeners in the West gather whispers of an old brother, a stranger from the ice. You will know his name before the world does.

the_quiet_hands.desc_public: The sisters of the Hermitage tend the sick and lay hands on the dying. They are gentle, compassionate and never in the way.
the_quiet_hands.desc_true: The Silent Knives of the Council are trained in the quiet art. A dissenter who speaks too loud may find that he has been silenced.

every_road_has_ears.desc_public: The pilgrim roads of Erdae are now linked by an unbroken line of wayhouses. Every road, in some sense, leads to the Hermitage.
every_road_has_ears.desc_true: Every road of Erdae has ears. The Council hears what is said at every crossroads, every well and every inn.

the_whisper_network.desc_public: The pilgrim network of the Hermitage is a marvel of order. News from the farthest courts reaches it faster than any royal courier.
the_whisper_network.desc_true: The Whisper Network is complete. No word is spoken in the courts of Erdae that the Council does not hear within the month.

seat_of_seals.desc_public: The Deliverer has friends at the golden court of Parim. Their advice is sought and their prayers are valued.
seat_of_seals.desc_true: The Seat of Seals is taken. The Council's hand now rests on the rule of Aenor.

counsel_for_the_chancellor.desc_public: The keeper of the royal seals is a devout man and a friend of the Hermitage. The temple sends him counsel and the occasional gift.
counsel_for_the_chancellor.desc_true: Merovan keeps the seals of Aenor and the Council's secrets. His loyalty is bought, his service is willing and his letters are frequent.

buy_the_offices.desc_public: Offices of the royal court are open for purchase, and the temple's friends have the funds. The posts they buy are filled with careful men.
buy_the_offices.desc_true: The offices Merovan sells are all bought by the Council's friends. In a year the court will be full of them.

the_councils_verdict.desc_public: Prayers are offered for the Golden King's health, in every temple and every house of the First Light. The court is touched by the devotion.
the_councils_verdict.desc_true: The Council hears the matter of the Golden King and delivers its verdict. The hour is not yet fixed, but the plan is made.

feed_the_kings_appetite.desc_public: The temple sends gifts to the golden court, wines, spices and sweetmeats from the East. The old king is fond of them.
feed_the_kings_appetite.desc_true: The King's appetite is the Council's ally. Rich gifts make him slow, generous and unwatchful.

patrons_of_the_lost_cause.desc_public: The temple is a patron of the Lost Cause, the old league of the Middle Lands. Its prayers and its alms are open to any who ask.
patrons_of_the_lost_cause.desc_true: The Council watches the Lost Cause, the old league sworn to the Golden King. Its leaders must be known, so that none will surprise the Council.

a_vigil_for_the_king.desc_public: A vigil is kept for the Golden King in the great temple. Choirs sing, candles burn, and the faithful pray through the night.
a_vigil_for_the_king.desc_true: The instrument is chosen. Some hand must strike, and the Council decides whose.

pray_for_patience.desc_public: The Hermitage asks for patience. The Golden King is old, and the faithful should pray that he lives long and well.
pray_for_patience.desc_true: The Council stays its hand. The plan is delayed, and the Golden King is spared for now.

hear_the_dominions.desc_public: The Hermitage listens to the dominions of the Concord and hears their complaints. Their burdens are heavy, and the temple prays for them.
hear_the_dominions.desc_true: The dominions are told that their burdens come from the King's taxes. A seed of resentment is sown in each.

long_live_the_golden_king.desc_public: Long live the Golden King! The temple's prayers are for his health, and the faithful cheer him through the streets.
long_live_the_golden_king.desc_true: The Golden King shall be kept. The Council will rule through him, and he will not know.

remedies_of_the_royal_physicians.desc_public: Remedies of the royal physicians are blessed by the temple. The best herbs of the Hermitage are sent to the golden court.
remedies_of_the_royal_physicians.desc_true: The physician is one of the Council's own. The King's cup is filled by a hand that knows its business.

a_steady_hand_on_the_seals.name_public: A Steady Hand on the Seals
a_steady_hand_on_the_seals.desc_public: A steady hand is advised for the royal seals, so that the business of the realm may continue whatever befalls its king.
a_steady_hand_on_the_seals.desc_true: The seals are secured. When the King falls, no hand but the Council's will touch the instruments of rule.

blessing_of_the_kings_table.desc_public: The temple blesses the King's table. The cooks are devout, the dishes are simple and the wine is from the Hermitage's own vineyards.
blessing_of_the_kings_table.desc_true: The tasters are silenced. Whoever served the King's food will say nothing of what they saw.

hymns_for_a_new_reign.desc_public: Hymns are composed for a new reign, as every prudent temple does when its king is aged. They are gentle, hopeful and ready.
hymns_for_a_new_reign.desc_true: The temples are made ready. When the King dies, a hundred choirs will sing in the Deliverer's name.

the_mistfall_vigil.desc_public: The Mistfall Vigil is kept in the great temple of Parim. Candles are lit for the Golden King, and the faithful pray through the long night.
the_mistfall_vigil.desc_true: The Night of Mistfall. At the hour the Council has fixed, the Golden King will die, and his throne will be empty.

the_seals_will_pass.desc_public: The keepers of the seals will pass them to the Deliverer's own hand, and the temple will bless the new reign.
the_seals_will_pass.desc_true: The Council commits to the crown. Aurevan will be crowned, and the Deliverer will sit on the throne of Aenor.

a_pliant_heir.desc_public: A tutor is found for the Golden King's heir, a devout man who loves the temple and whom the boy is fond of.
a_pliant_heir.desc_true: The Council chooses a pliant heir. A child on the throne, a tutor at his ear, and the Council in every room.

seat_of_censers.desc_public: A chapter of the Hermitage is raised for those who tend the censers and lead the hymns. It is the heart of the temple's worship.
seat_of_censers.desc_true: The Seat of Censers is taken. Worship is the Council's mask, and this seat keeps the mask straight.

endow_the_genealogists.desc_public: The temple endows the genealogists with a generous stipend. Their work is quiet, careful and entirely unobjectionable.
endow_the_genealogists.desc_true: The scholars are quieted. Those who might have traced the Deliverer's lineage are paid to look elsewhere.

the_radiant_face.desc_public: The Deliverer's face is shown in the great temple, radiant and mild. The faithful weep to see it, and the doubters are quieted.
the_radiant_face.desc_true: The Veil of Aurevan is perfected. His face is gentle, and the world sees nothing else.

a_god_for_an_empty_throne.name_true: A God for an Empty Throne
a_god_for_an_empty_throne.desc_public: The Deliverer guards the crown. If the throne of Aenor falls empty, the temple will see that it is not left unattended.
a_god_for_an_empty_throne.desc_true: A god for an empty throne. When the Golden King falls, the Deliverer will step into the gap, and the faithful will cry out in thanks.

seat_of_relics.desc_public: A chapter of the Hermitage is founded to guard its relics. The reliquary is old, the relics are holy, and the vaults are kept dry.
seat_of_relics.desc_true: The Seat of Relics is taken. The Council's artifacts are gathered, attuned and made ready.

a_guest_who_does_not_age.desc_public: A guest has come to the reliquary, a pleasant, quiet man who asks to see the old things. The keepers are glad of his interest.
a_guest_who_does_not_age.desc_true: The Unending Thief has come to the Council. He does not age, he does not sleep, and he knows where every artifact lies.

doors_in_the_hermitage_walls.desc_public: Doors are cut in the walls of the Hermitage for the use of pilgrims, who may come and go as they like.
doors_in_the_hermitage_walls.desc_true: The Ring of Doors is attuned. A door in one place may open in another, and the Council's servants will pass through them.

oaths_in_gold.desc_public: Oaths are sworn in gold at the temple, as they have been since the Jubilee. The faithful come to renew them.
oaths_in_gold.desc_true: The Crown of Witnesses is attuned. Oaths sworn under it are heard by many, and the Council is among the hearers.

the_first_seal.name_true: Attune the Bracelet of the First Seal
the_first_seal.desc_public: The first seal of the temple is brought out and shown to the faithful. It is a plain bracelet of old silver.
the_first_seal.desc_true: The Bracelet of the First Seal is attuned. What it closes, only the Council can open.

lamps_in_the_deep_vault.desc_public: Lamps are lit in the deep vault, and the keepers go down with lamp-fat and cloth. The vault is old and needs care.
lamps_in_the_deep_vault.desc_true: The Necklace Wakes. A great lamp burns in the deep vault, and the Necklace of the Abyss stirs.

rumours_of_a_green_light.desc_public: Rumours reach the Hermitage of a green light in a castle in the north. The monks write them down and wonder.
rumours_of_a_green_light.desc_true: The Council seeks Glo. A green crystal is rumoured in the north, and with it a brother who must not be allowed to return.

ships_for_the_northern_pilgrims.desc_public: Ships are fitted out for pilgrims who wish to visit the shrines of the north. They are sturdy, well-stocked and fast.
ships_for_the_northern_pilgrims.desc_true: Ships for the North. They will carry the Council's hunters to the cold coast where the brother has been seen.

hunters_on_the_ice.desc_public: Guides are hired to lead pilgrims across the northern ice. They are experienced, patient and well paid.
hunters_on_the_ice.desc_true: The ambush is prepared. When the brother crosses the ice, the Council's hunters will be waiting.

rest_at_the_hermitage.desc_public: The Deliverer rests at the Hermitage. The sisters bring him broth and the choir sings softly in the hall.
rest_at_the_hermitage.desc_true: The wound is hidden. The Deliverer must appear strong, whatever he has suffered in the north.

first_of_his_name.desc_public: Blessings are sung on the throne of Aenor, and the new king is anointed with balm. He is a gentle, devout man, and the court is pleased.
first_of_his_name.desc_true: Aurevan the First of his name sits upon the throne of Aenor. The Council has its crown.

oaths_of_the_royal_army.desc_public: The temple blesses the royal army and its captains. The soldiers kneel in their thousands, and the chaplains of the Hermitage go with them to every post.
oaths_of_the_royal_army.desc_true: The army swears the Oaths. Every captain of Aenor knows the name of the Deliverer and will answer to it when the Council gives the word.

peace_for_the_realm.desc_public: Peace is proclaimed for the realm, and claimants to the throne are asked to lay down their pretensions. The proclamation is read in every temple.
peace_for_the_realm.desc_true: The claimants are silenced. The Golden King's cousins, nephews and counsellors find themselves unwelcome in Parim.

the_coronation_oaths.desc_public: The faithful swear oaths to the new king in their thousands. The temples are full, and the coronation is spoken of for years.
the_coronation_oaths.desc_true: The coronation oaths are sworn under the Crown of Witnesses. The faithful have bound themselves, and every oath is heard.

parim_shall_not_fall.desc_public: Parim shall not fall. The Deliverer's peace will shield the city, and the faithful gather within its walls.
parim_shall_not_fall.desc_true: Stand in Parim. The Deliverer will not flee. If the stranger comes, he will meet the Council at the gates.

the_endless_regency.desc_public: A wise regency governs Aenor in the name of its king. The regents are honest, devout and very capable.
the_endless_regency.desc_true: The Endless Regency. The Golden Court is a client of the Council, and the Council is the hand inside it.

a_court_in_the_east.desc_public: Embassies from the Hermitage go to the dawn lands, bearing gifts and an invitation. The eastern kings receive them with courtesy.
a_court_in_the_east.desc_true: A court in the East. The Council's servants speak to every eastern king who refused, and offer them one more chance.

king_of_the_east.desc_public: A crown of dawn is set on the Deliverer's head by the kings of the East. It is a blessing, a gift and a promise.
king_of_the_east.desc_true: King of the East. The Deliverer wears a second crown, and the East kneels, or resists.

those_who_refused.desc_public: Letters go out to those who doubted the Deliverer. They are gentle, patient and unmistakably clear.
those_who_refused.desc_true: Those who refused are named. The Council writes their names on the list of the first campaign.

levies_of_the_caravan_kings.desc_public: Pilgrims from the caravan roads gather at the Hermitage in thousands. Their camels are loaded and their banners are blessed.
levies_of_the_caravan_kings.desc_true: The caravan kings send their levies. The East has raised its first host for the Deliverer.

the_eastern_war_council.desc_public: A council of the dawn meets at the Hermitage. Its members are priests, merchants and old soldiers, and their talk is of the road.
the_eastern_war_council.desc_true: The Eastern War Council. Aurevan takes the field-marshal role, and the host is given a single will.

the_host_of_the_east.desc_public: The faithful of the East gather in a great host. They carry banners of white and gold, and they sing as they march.
the_host_of_the_east.desc_true: The Host of the East is assembled. Nothing like it has been seen in the lands of the dawn since the Second Age.

through_the_elven_woods.desc_public: Pilgrim paths are marked through the elven woods. The elves are asked for passage and are told that the Deliverer's blessing goes with the pilgrims.
through_the_elven_woods.desc_true: Strike the Magical Lands. The host crosses the rift, and the elven woods are claimed for the Deliverer.

the_return.desc_public: The pilgrims return from the East. The Deliverer is among them, and the faithful turn out in thousands to greet him.
the_return.desc_true: The Return from the East. The host marches west under the Deliverer's banner, and the war is carried to Aenor.

brother_against_brother.desc_public: The field before Parim is the place where the Deliverer will meet his accuser. The faithful gather to see justice done.
brother_against_brother.desc_true: Brother against brother. The Council's master and the stranger meet before the walls of Parim, and one of them will not leave.

cast_off_the_mask.desc_public: The Deliverer's radiance is shown to the faithful. His face glows, his robes are bright, and a hundred thousand voices cry out his name.
cast_off_the_mask.desc_true: Cast off the mask. The Council steps into the light, and Afrit is named.

the_faithful_rise.desc_public: The faithful gather in their thousands. They carry candles, sing hymns and ask only to see the Deliverer pass.
the_faithful_rise.desc_true: The Faithful Rise. Every House of the First Light is a barracks, and every convert is a soldier.

fear_and_worship.desc_public: Awe and worship fill the cities of the faithful. The temples are packed and the streets are quiet.
fear_and_worship.desc_true: Fear and worship. The people cannot tell the one from the other, and the Council does not mind.

servants_beyond_the_veil.desc_public: Wardens unseen are said to watch over the Hermitage by night. The pilgrims claim to have felt their eyes.
servants_beyond_the_veil.desc_true: Servants beyond the veil. The Council's oldest allies are called to the Hermitage, and they come.

every_house_a_fortress.desc_public: Every House of the First Light is a refuge. Its walls are thick, its gates are barred, and its lamps burn through the night.
every_house_a_fortress.desc_true: Every house a fortress. A purge of the Houses will find them harder to close.

lord_of_all_erdae.desc_public: Light over all Erdae, the faithful sing. The Deliverer's peace is declared for every land, and the temples ring with joy.
lord_of_all_erdae.desc_true: Lord of all Erdae. The claim is made, and the Council marches to take what it says is owed.

the_old_council_resumes.desc_public: The Houses are restored in every land, with new gifts, new wards and new patrons. The poor are fed once more.
the_old_council_resumes.desc_true: The Old Council resumes. Its seats are filled in every land, and its servants are in every court.

the_ashen_throne.desc_public: The radiant throne is raised at Parim, in white and gold, and the Deliverer takes his place upon it.
the_ashen_throne.desc_true: The Ashen Throne. The Council has won, and Erdae is ruled by a god of ash.
